scope: Audited registry of 12 major PRAISE research/evidence episodes, including historical pilot, registered Phase-5 battery, Phase-6 matched information-interface development and selected recent retrospective diagnostics. Not an exhaustive catalog of all experimental scripts.
evaluation_semantics: sigma_G(A,H;rho) = Pr(c_G(A,H)>=rho), c_G is fraction of SLA-compliant decided requests by H. Late deadline failures count as decided noncompliance; zero decisions compliant. Not first-violation survival.
